bugs.title: Vertical ad creative is cropped instead of displayed with FIT
bugs.symptom: Vertical video ads remain cropped in the full-screen sponsored viewer and behave like COVER/fill instead of FIT/contain.
working_comparisons: Expected full vertical frame centered with black side space
bugs.root_cause: The previous repair still depended on object-fit while competing code rewrote the physical video element dimensions. The rendered box remained vulnerable to viewport-fill geometry.
bugs.fix_summary: Repair candidate deployed: fitguard2 now reads native videoWidth/videoHeight and physically sizes the video element to the largest source-ratio rectangle that fits the live ad stage. Desktop cache-bust is live. User verification is still required.
bugs.future_repair: Verify the live native video dimensions and final physical box. A 9:16 ad must render as a narrow centered rectangle with black side space.

bugs.title: Ads CMS break cadence is ignored and ads play every other song
bugs.symptom: The Ads CMS is set to run an ad after every song/video, but DEV V2 still inserts commercials every other song/video.
affected_examples: DEV V2 desktop live sequence on 2026-08-21
working_comparisons: CMS controller displays After every song/video
Expected Song -> Ad -> Song -> Ad sequence
bugs.root_cause: The previous repair still depended on the timing of the next real V2 audio generation to claim an owed break. Reused or remounted audio could leave the break pending into the following song.
bugs.fix_summary: Repair candidate deployed: cadenceguard2 claims the runtime's pending break immediately at the natural song boundary with a dedicated proxy, pauses the next real song while the ad plays, then resumes that song when the break finishes. It does not create a second cadence counter. User verification is still required.
bugs.future_repair: Verify three consecutive natural completions with CMS breakInterval 1. Each completion must move breakPending to adPlaying before the next song audibly advances.
